sql.question: For each portfolio, show the total value of Technology sector holdings and what percentage it represents of the total portfolio value
sql.message: This query calculates the total market value of Technology sector holdings and its percentage relative to the total market value of all holdings for each portfolio.
sql.sql: SELECT p.portfolio_name, SUM(CASE WHEN sec.sector_name = 'Technology' THEN h.quantity * s.current_price ELSE 0 END) AS tech_holding_value, SUM(CASE WHEN sec.sector_name = 'Technology' THEN h.quantity * s.current_price ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(h.quantity * s.current_price) AS tech_percentage FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id JOIN securities s ON h.security_id = s.security_id LEFT JOIN sectors sec ON s.sector_id = sec.sector_id GROUP BY p.portfolio_id, p.portfolio_name

sql.question: Find portfolios that have holdings in more than 5 different sectors and show their diversification metrics
sql.message: Returns portfolios holding securities across more than 5 distinct sectors along with their sector count, total holdings count, and diversification ratio.
sql.sql: SELECT p.portfolio_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.sector_id) AS distinct_sectors, COUNT(h.holding_id) AS total_holdings, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT s.sector_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(h.holding_id) AS diversification_ratio FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id JOIN securities sec ON h.security_id = sec.security_id LEFT JOIN sectors s ON sec.sector_id = s.sector_id GROUP BY p.portfolio_id, p.portfolio_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.sector_id) > 5
